title: Fox wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <polygon points='74,33 69,17 62,29' fill='#7a2f2f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#f08434'/>

  <ellipse cx='66' cy='62' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#f9a15c'/>

  <rect x='24' y='44' width='23' height='16' rx='6' fill='#3a2a5a'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='51' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='51' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
